get.description: The distinct labels on the project's work items, sorted, for suggestions.

The live title and status (`needs_person`, `running`, `ready`, `blocked` or `closed`) of each comma-separated work item id that is in the project, in the order asked, up to 100. Ids that don't exist, were deleted or are in another project are left out.
The project's members with their username and avatar, ordered by username. Members only: 403 for a non-member, even on a public project.

post.description: Starts a standalone Task from a step-definition version or a prompt. Responds 409 `Scarn.ConcurrencyGroupFull` when the step's concurrency group on the work item is full: no Task is created, and `meta.heldBy` names the Tasks that hold the group.

Stops an agent Task: it ends `cancelled`. Requires `executions:write` on the Task's project. A Task a pipeline step owns is stopped by cancelling its whole pipeline execution. Responds 422 `TASK_CANCEL_CODE_TASK` for a code Task and 422 `TASK_ALREADY_ENDED` for a Task that already ended.

Retries a failed or cancelled standalone Task in place. Requires executions:write on its project. Pipeline-owned Tasks must be rerun through their pipeline. The required nullable expectedLatestRunId must match the latest run (null only when no run exists); stale requests return 409. Cancelled Tasks without runs restart their initial attempt, remaining waiting_for_work with taskRunId null while blockers are open. Existing attempts retry despite later blockers. Returns 422 for unsupported Tasks or states and 409 when the concurrency group is full.

Records that the task run's agent ended its turn with a yield; the task run ends `yielded`. It hands the conversation to a person: when it belongs to a pipeline run, the run posts `message` to the step visit's conversation and waits for a reply. Requires the claim token and `executions:write`.

Mints a presigned PUT URL for the task run's exported agent session (`tasks/<taskRunId>/session.json`). The worker uploads the export, then passes the returned `objectKey` when it yields. Requires the claim token and `executions:write`.

Reads a work item live for the running task run's agent with a `read` grant on `self` for its own item, `children` for a direct child, or `project` for any item in the same project. Returns the description with its `descriptionVersion`, labels, fields and state, and its blockers and children, each with its labels, state, close reason, open blockers (`blockedBy`) and newest Task's status (`latestTaskStatus`). Includes a page of the item's posted comments with display-only author names, totalCount and nextCursor; pass commentsCursor to continue reading that same item's comments. Comments require no additional permission. Authorized by a live claim token alone; no session.

Creates a child of the running task run's work item for its agent, committed at once, as the user who claimed the run. Needs the Task's `create` grant on `children`, covering every label; `blockedBy` must name existing items that are the Task's own item or its children. At most 10 items per Task and 50 open children per item. Returns 201, or 200 with `created: false` when `workItemId` already names this Task's child (a retry). Authorized by the claim token alone; no session.
Starts a run of the pipeline's active version, or of `version` when given, and advances it to its first step.
Reruns a step visit: it and every visit downstream of it are superseded and the node is visited again.

Answers the visit waiting on an open question: the reply is saved as a threaded comment under the question's comment, the question becomes answered by the caller, and the wait's result is `{ replied: true, body, commentId }`. A question that isn't open is rejected (`PIPELINE_RUN_QUESTION_NOT_OPEN`) and nothing is saved. Requires `comments:create`.

Resumes the visit waiting on an open question without a reply: the question becomes answered with no answer comment and the wait's result is `{ replied: false, body: null, commentId: null }`. Requires `executions:write`.
Issues a short-lived token for subscribing to push wake-ups for the project's queued work. 404 when push is not configured; workers then keep polling.

Refreshes the worker's write token for the task run's live log feed. Requires the claim token and `executions:write`. 404 when the live feed is not configured; append over `POST /task-runs/:taskRunId/logs` instead.

get.description: A read token for the task run's live log feed. Requires `executions:read`. 404 when the live feed is not configured; poll `GET /task-runs/:taskRunId/logs` instead.

put.description: Batch-cancels pipeline executions. Requires `executions:write` on each execution's project. Executions in the batch that are not in a cancelable state (already finished, cancelled, etc.) are skipped rather than cancelled, and are reported in `skippedIds` alongside the `cancelledIds` that were actually cancelled.

post.description: Sends a message to a step visit of a pipeline execution. Requires `executions:write`. Reruns the visit; its new Task carries the message. Code steps don't accept messages.
Records a decision on a waiting decision visit. Requires `executions:write`.

get.description: A visit's conversation: its latest Task and every earlier run it continues, oldest first, with the messages sent to each. Requires `executions:read`.

The question comments runs posted on a work item, oldest first, each with the run and visit that asked it and its status (`open`, `answered` or `not_needed`). The comments UI reads it so the comments API needn't know about runs. Requires `comments:read`.
A conversation with its messages, oldest first, the step visit it belongs to, and how that step ends (`findings` or `conversation`). Requires `executions:read`.

delete.description: Deletes a chat in any state, with its transcript, Task, runs, logs, sessions, artifacts and notifications; stored objects are removed after. Returns 204. Same permission as End. 404 when the conversation isn't a chat.

get.description: A work item's conversations, newest first, each with its status, step node and last message time. Requires `executions:read`.

A project's chats (repo conversations, not work items' conversations), newest first, each with its first-message preview, creator, derived state, last activity and short pinned commit. Pass `nextCursor` as `before` for the next page. Requires `executions:read`.

post.description: Opens a chat about the project's repo with the person's first question (`{ body }` only; any other field is refused with 422) and queues the agent's first turn. Returns 201 with the conversation. Requires `executions:write`.

Replies in a conversation. Requires `comments:create`. The first reply while the agent waits queues its next turn; more replies join that turn until it starts. Refused with `CONVERSATION_NOT_WAITING` once the agent has the floor or the conversation is closed, and on a failed chat with `CONVERSATION_TASK_FAILED` (retry it instead).
Queues the agent's next turn without a reply. Requires `executions:write`. Only while the conversation waits for a person (`CONVERSATION_NOT_WAITING` otherwise).

Ends a conversation step (one with no result schema): the step succeeds with `{ conversationId, summary }`, the summary being the last agent message, and the conversation closes. Requires `executions:write`. Only while the conversation waits for a person (`CONVERSATION_NOT_WAITING`); refused on a step with a result schema (`CONVERSATION_STEP_HAS_RESULT_SCHEMA`).

Retries a failed chat's turn. `expectedLatestRunId` must be the chat's latest run (`latestRun.id`); a stale value gets 409, so repeating a retry makes one new run. Refused on an ended chat (409 `CONVERSATION_ENDED`). Requires `executions:write`. 404 when the conversation isn't a chat.

Ends a chat: its conversation closes and a queued, running or waiting turn is cancelled. The transcript stays readable. Ending an ended chat does nothing. Requires `executions:write`, or being its creator with `comments:create`. 404 when the conversation isn't a chat (see `/done` for a conversation step).

patch.description: A description edit names the descriptionVersion it loaded. 409 when the description has changed since.

get.description: Lists a work item's direct children, oldest first, each with its status (`needs_person`, `running`, `ready`, `blocked` or `closed`), assignee, open blockers' titles and newest Task: its step, first start, and the question it handed over or the error it failed with.

patch.description: Add then remove labels on a native work item. 409 for a synced item, whose labels come from its tracker.

post.description: Creates a comment, or a reply when `parentCommentId` names a top-level comment. A reply to a question's comment is a plain comment and doesn't answer it; `POST /pipeline-executions/:id/questions/:questionId/answer` does. Requires `comments:create`.

patch.description: Edits a comment's body. A question comment can't be edited while its question is open (`WORK_ITEM_COMMENT_QUESTION_OPEN`).

delete.description: Deletes a comment. A question comment can't be deleted while its question is open (`WORK_ITEM_COMMENT_QUESTION_OPEN`).

get.description: The project's open pipeline waits on the caller, newest first: open questions (`kind: reply`) and decision waits on unfinished runs (`kind: decision`, with the node's actions). A wait is on the caller when they created the work item or started the run. At most 200. `workItems` lists the open, ready work items that have never had a Task and wait on the caller, most recently ready first: the caller is the item's assignee or creator or, when it has neither, the nearest parent's that has either. At most 200. Members only: 403 for a non-member, even on a public project.

The counts behind the caller's inbox badge: agent Tasks waiting on them, open pipeline waits on them, failed Tasks they started (not those of ended chats) and ready work items never given a Task that wait on them (`badgeCount` sums the four), plus the Tasks waiting on someone else. Members only: 403 for a non-member, even on a public project.
